2 · Promise and Owner Scenarios

What success must feel like

Owner-approved target journeys. Their current truth and plan states keep approved intent separate from shipped behavior and authorized work.

S1NOT BUILTBLOCKEDAPPROVED

The fresh first Angel

Claim or goal
“From a blank machine and new identity, I can use public docs—or ask a fresh agent—to create an Angel, run it locally, publish it to Angel Cloud, inspect it in www, use it in production, verify what it can and cannot do, then delete everything and restart without admin help.”
Boundary
Round 2 supports CLI and max-agent setup plus read-only www. Human authentication, consent, and final inspection stay human. “Delete everything” means the O6 cloud cascade once approved; independent local files and tokens remain separate. Self-hosting is not implied.
Evidence
Fresh-agent preflight and Sam dogfood both complete local and managed paths, prove cleanup, and save evidence.

3 · Product Guarantees

The target laws, current truth, and limits

G01LIVE

G01 · Angel is a toolbox, never an actor

Only the user’s agent initiates an MCP call; Angel has no loop, intent, scheduler, or mailbox.

What this means to Sam
Nothing happens until my own agent asks for a specific tool call.
Current truth state
LIVE Demonstrated
Boundary
Angel does not supply the agent or decide what task to attempt.

7 · Governance

One product truth; execution findings roll up

Status key: truth LIVE PARTIAL BROKEN NOT BUILT · plan COMPLETE ACTIVE NEXT BLOCKED LATER · approval APPROVED PROPOSED · records OPEN CLOSED.

Product Ledger

Promise, scenarios, guarantees, Product Anatomy, path, decisions, proof status, and learning disposition.

GitHub Issues

Durable execution work, bugs, investigations, priority, assignee, and cross-session state.

Repo build artifacts

Exact ADRs, specs, evals, tests, plans, handoffs, fixtures, and code.

Temporary agent state

Local notes only; promote durable execution to Issues and product truth to the Ledger.

Co-located rule: update this Ledger in the same PR when Angel product truth changes. A GitHub Issue must not become a second roadmap. For split repositories, contract v0.1 requires a Ledger intent PR before implementation and a Ledger truth PR after merged proof. In this system, adding Linear is unnecessary.
Optional-module appendix

Optional modules — none adopted

The approved registry is empty in approved v0.1. Candidate names link to the canonical contract; no candidate definition is copied here.

Adopted — none

N/A — Sam adopted no optional module for Angel.

Available — none

N/A — approved contract v0.1 exposes no contract-available module.

Project-specific candidates — none

N/A — no Angel-only module awaits owner agreement.

Seven contract candidates pinned to approved v0.1

Contract candidates are discussion prompts, not approved scope.

  • Reliability and Operations Window
  • Security, Privacy, and Compliance Window
  • Customer and Market Evidence Window
  • Commercial and Cost Window
  • Ecosystem and Compatibility Window
  • Rollout and Migration Window
  • AI and Data Quality Window

  1. Current user manual, domain architecture, ADRs, and product decisions on main.
  2. Current executable tests and 62 committed www screenshots/manual images.
